meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 装上后,把纯文本或 Markdown 文件处理成结构清晰的 Markdown:补写 frontmatter、标题、摘要,加粗重点,转列表,标注代码块和引用,并修正中英文间距和引号。结果另存为「原文件名-formatted.md」。
howto.when: 当你要求「格式化 markdown」「美化文章」「添加格式」或改善文章排版时触发;如果原文已是 Markdown,会先询问优化方式。

say.text: 把 final.md 格式化一下
给这段纯文本加上标题和列表
美化这篇文章,保留原有的小标题
say.note: 会先问你要不要保留原格式

howto.what_en: Turns plain text or markdown files into well-structured markdown: adds/updates frontmatter, title, summary, bold, lists, code blocks, blockquotes, fixes CJK/English spacing and quotes. Saves as {filename}-formatted.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. If source is already markdown, it asks how to proceed.

say_en.text: Add headings and lists to this plain text
Beautify this article, keep the original subheadings
